description: Quote the connected account's exact Gold price for the faction heraldry kit workflow: create faction heraldry from an owned reference image. Returns gold_cost, affordable and quote_token without starting a run, moderating, charging Gold or consuming a free sheet. After the user approves the price, call chargen_run_recipe_faction_heraldry_kit with the same values and quote_token. For input rules, use chargen_get_recipe_faction_heraldry_kit.
